copies.text_now: Because Agello a691212 sets no maxInputLength, its EmbeddingGemma engine loads signatures up to 1,024 tokens, so a passage or query plus its prompt prefix is read up to 1,022 SentencePiece tokens (1,024 with BOS and EOS); Agello asks LiteRT-LM to truncate a longer input rather than fail (inputOverflowStrategy .truncate), and its chunker sizes passages by estimated quarter tokens (1,600, about 400 tokens), not by the tokenizer.

copies.text_now: Agello at 93122b647a shows nothing while it hosts unit or device tests (AgelloApp.hostsTests, set when XCTestConfigurationFilePath is present; its comment says this keeps the app from warming up a second engine). With our build fc71d704a349 on the iPhone 17 Pro, the leftover breakdowns read after unloading the tests' engine at the start of the 3.5 GB and 4.0 GB envelope scenarios were 1.411 and 1.846 GB of footprint (0.763 and 0.764 GB graphics) in memory-host-engine-breakdown.json, with the host's own engine loaded, against 0.124 and 0.489 GB (0.001 and 0.002 GB graphics) in memory-host-idle.json, with the host idle.
